holders.label: US government
holders.note: Equity the US federal government took in companies since 2025, as announced by the agencies and the companies. Each listed company's row cites the company's SEC filing or the agency's release; the list was cross-checked against a public tracker (theoagseo.com, updated 2026-10-21). 'held' = shares or warrants issued; 'agreed' = definitive agreement, securities not yet delivered; 'loi' = letter of intent; 'conditional' = tied to a loan or condition not yet met; 'unit' / 'project' = equity in a subsidiary, joint venture or project, not in the listed parent. Revenue-share deals (Nvidia's and AMD's China chip sales) are not equity and are not listed.

holders.label: President Trump
holders.note: The President's periodic transaction reports (OGE Form 278-T) are posted as scanned PDFs; these rows are read by machine from the PDFs' text layer, or by OCR where a scan has none. Descriptions can be misread, a few rows in a hundred are not read (each report shows its coverage), a type that could not be read is taken from the rows around it (marked), so is a date that could not be read (marked), and amounts are OGE's ranges (net = purchases − sales at range midpoints, a rough guide, not a position). Each row links to its report and page. Assets the reports exclude (Treasuries, mutual funds, money market) are not here; the annual reports (278e) are listed, not read.
